name: APPEAL_GRV_LETTER_GEN_HX
description: All successes, failures, and intermediate actions that occurred while generating letters.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the appeal/grievance record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: CM_PHY_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance that owns this record or line. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: HISTORY_KEY
columns.description: GRP 5100 is sorted by occur instant, but if the TAG record is locked by a different process when we try to log an action, we will have to wait and try again later. This means that the occur instant may not exactly correlate the order in which certain lines were logged. This item keeps track of the technical order that actions were logged.

columns.name: LETTER_HX_GUID
columns.description: The letter that caused this history action will have a matching GUID in I TAG 5020.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_LETTER_ACT_C_NAME
columns.description: The action that occurred to cause this line to be logged.

columns.name: OCCUR_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant that the action logged in I TAG 5103 occurred.

columns.name: COMMITTING_USER_ID
columns.description: The logged in user of the process that caused this action to occur.

columns.name: COMMITTING_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: LETTER_HX_COMMENT
columns.description: Any details that are too specific to be recorded with the history action (I TAG 5103), like specific error messages, can be recorded here.
